subcommands.name: bootstrap
subcommands.description: Bootstrap the packages in the current Lerna repo. Installing all their dependencies and linking any cross-dependencies

options.name: --scope
options.description: Include only packages with names matching the given glob

options.description: Exclude packages with names matching the given glob

options.name: --no-private
options.description: Exclude private packages. They are included by default

options.name: --since
options.description: Only include packages that have been changed since the specified ref. If no ref is passed, it defaults to the most-recent tag

options.name: --hoist
options.description: Install external dependencies matching glob at the repo root so they're available to all packages

options.name: --nohoist
options.description: Do not install external dependencies matching glob at the repo root. This can be used to opt out of hoisting for certain dependencies

options.name: --strict
options.description: When used in conjunction with hoist will throw an error and stop bootstrapping after emitting the version warnings. Has no effect if you aren't hoisting, or if there are no version warnings

options.name: --ignore-prepublish
options.description: Skip prepublish lifecycle scripts run by default in bootstrapped packages

options.name: --ignore-scripts
options.description: Skip any lifecycle scripts normally run (prepare, etc) in bootstrapped packages

options.name: --registry
options.description: Forwarded npm commands will use the specified registry for your package(s)

options.name: --use-workspaces
options.description: Enables integration with Yarn Workspaces

options.name: --force-local
options.description: When passed, this flag causes the bootstrap command to always symlink local dependencies regardless of matching version range
